title: Do You Tip the Skipper on a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: No, you do not have to tip the skipper on a boat trip in Madeira. Tipping in Portugal is an optional thank-you, usually small and in cash, given at the end.
heroAlt: A skipper seen from behind tying a white boat to the pontoon at Marina do Funchal
keywords: do you tip the skipper on a boat trip in Madeira
tipping on a boat trip Madeira
how much to tip a boat skipper Portugal
